narrative.headline: Healthcare flow dominates with concentrated bullish positioning in Healthcare Plans and select Pharma, but the sector is split with major names showing aggressive bearish flow.
bullish_themes: Healthcare Plans showing the cleanest bullish cluster (CVS, ELV bullish; CNC, UNH, MOH lean bullish) — managed care rotation thesis
Drug Manufacturers bifurcated — BMY and JNJ pulling 100% bullish flow while LLY, ABBV, AMGN see heavy bearish positioning
Precious metals split — CDE bullish on miners while AU and RGLD show bearish flow, suggesting single-name selection over sector bet
Airlines internally conflicted — ALK 100% bullish but UAL and especially AAL ($13.3M bearish premium) point the other way
notable_individual_flows: AAL — $13.3M premium at 98% bearish, the single loudest print in the scan and a clear airline-sector warning
CVS — score 9.5, $1M premium, 100% bullish with 7 ask-side prints, cleanest bullish setup
LLY — $4.2M premium leaning 58% bearish, notable given LLY's typical bullish bias
BMY — 100% bullish with 4 ask-side bull prints, contrarian pharma long signal
CNC — $1.79M premium lean bullish, largest Healthcare Plans bull commitment by size
narrative.absences: No bullish flow registered in XLK, XLC, XLY, or XLF despite broad coverage — tech, communications, discretionary, and financials are silent. Energy (XLE) also absent from the bullish tape.
